sentences.text: Chicken on 29 of 154 meals and treats: Dentastix (label lists chicken) daily from Jun 8, on the owner-entered allowed list; at least 4 off-list, the last Jun 27.
Owner-entered: Royal Canin HP, hydrolysed soy, day 46 of 56 since May 18, directed by Dr. A. Chen. No chicken-free day recorded since Jun 8.

Itching: 16 entries on 16 of 43 logged days, over at least 35 days (chronicity flag). Not a test of the diet: Apoquel (doses not logged), NexGard from Jun 5 and Dentastix from Jun 8 overlap the trial.
Apoquel 16 mg once daily, prescribed Apr 30: doses not logged in Culprit.
NexGard 68 mg chew, Jun 5 and Jul 2: flavour protein unknown, not counted off-list.

Owner's words, Jun 18: “flare after the chicken on Sunday”, Sunday being Jun 14. Not tested: chicken was fed daily from Jun 8; before then (May 18 to Jun 7, trial weeks 1 to 3) chicken was logged only on Jun 2, so any comparison is confounded by the trial's own start.
Also logged: loose stool Jun 22; 1 meal not finished Jun 24.
Weight, home scale: −0.6 kg, −1.9%, 32.4 kg May 18 to 31.8 kg Jun 29, 3 readings.
